nights.title: Rondò Veneziano
nights.name: Rondò Veneziano
nights.extract: Rondò Veneziano is an Italian chamber orchestra, specializing in Baroque music, playing original instruments, but incorporating a rock-style rhythm section of synthesizer, bass guitar and drums, originally led by Maestro Gian Piero Reverberi, who is also the principal composer of all of the original Rondò Veneziano pieces. The unusual addition of modern instruments, more suitable for jazz, combined with Reverberi's arrangements and original compositions, have resulted in lavish novel versions of classical works over the years. As a rule in their concert tours, the musicians, mostly women, add to the overall Baroque effect wearing Baroque-era attire and coiffures. The orchestra's album sales

en.kicker: chamber orchestra · baroque music with rock rhythm
en.who: Rondò Veneziano is an Italian chamber orchestra that specializes in Baroque music. It plays on original instruments, with a rock-style rhythm section. The orchestra was originally led by Maestro Gian Piero Reverberi, its principal composer.
facts: The orchestra plays Baroque music on original instruments, with a rock-style rhythm section of synthesizer, bass guitar and drums.
On concert tours, the musicians, who are mostly women, wear Baroque-era attire and coiffures.

de.who: Rondò Veneziano ist ein italienisches Kammerorchester, das auf Barockmusik spezialisiert ist und auf originalen Instrumenten spielt. Die Rhythmusgruppe hat einen rockartigen Stil. Das Orchester wurde ursprünglich von Maestro Gian Piero Reverberi geleitet, dem Hauptkomponisten.
facts: Das Orchester spielt Barockmusik auf originalen Instrumenten, ergänzt durch einen rockartigen Rhythmusteil mit Synthesizer, E-Bass und Schlagzeug.
Auf Konzertreisen tragen die Musiker, meist Frauen, Kleidung und Frisuren aus der Barockzeit.

tr.kicker: oda orkestrası · rock ritimli barok müziği
tr.who: Rondò Veneziano, barok müziğini özgün enstrümanlarla çalan İtalyan bir oda orkestrasıdır. Ritim bölümünde rock tarzı bir yapı kullanılır. Orkestra başlangıçta, orijinal parçaların başlıca bestecisi olan Maestro Gian Piero Reverberi tarafından yönetildi.
facts: Orkestra, barok müziğini özgün enstrümanlarla çalar ve ritim bölümünde sentezleyici, bas gitar ve davul kullanır.
Konser turlarında çoğunluğu kadın olan müzisyenler barok dönemi kıyafetleri ve saç modelleri giyer.
